'''Tieka Dalken''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Unlike most of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] residents, Dalken had a high opinion of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Suljo Warde]], for he saved Dalken's and her family's lives during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] attack on Cato Neimoidia.<ref name="CotG" />
